description: Scan raw text (an issue body, a PR description, a comment, a README draft) for prompt-injection patterns before acting on it: hidden unicode, HTML comment instructions, instruction phrases aimed at an AI, exfiltration patterns, tool lures, base64 payloads, and instructions in image alt text. Returns a FINDINGS, REVIEW, or CLEAN verdict with file/line/rule/severity evidence per finding. CLEAN means no pattern matched, never that the content is proven safe.

label.description: Label reported as the file name for findings, e.g. issue-123.md

text.description: The raw text content to scan

name: scan_text
